SELECT 'crm'::text AS source_name, pgtrickle.encode_row_id_v2('MDM_SOURCE_KEY_V1', ROW((SELECT entity_id FROM mdm_graph.source_identity_map WHERE entity_name = 'customer' AND source_name = 'crm'), (SELECT source_identity_id FROM mdm_graph.source_identity_map WHERE entity_name = 'customer' AND source_name = 'crm'), "id")) AS source_record_key, "email_addr" AS "email", 'present'::text AS "email_state"
FROM public.crm_customer

SELECT 'crm'::text AS source_name, s.source_record_key, sr.source_record_id, sr.source_record_key AS source_sort_key, 'email'::text AS field_name, s.raw_value, s.row_changed_at, (n).state, (n).normalized, (n).canonical_bytes
FROM (SELECT source_record_key, "email"::text AS raw_value, NULL::timestamptz AS row_changed_at, mdm_graph.normalize_text(("email")::text, 'email', 1, "email_state", '{}'::jsonb) AS n FROM @{records/crm}) s
JOIN mdm_graph.source_records sr ON sr.source_record_key = s.source_record_key AND sr.active
JOIN mdm_graph.source_identity_map si ON si.source_identity_id = sr.source_identity_id AND si.source_name = 'crm'

SELECT NULL::uuid AS left_source_record_id, NULL::uuid AS right_source_record_id, NULL::bytea AS left_sort_key, NULL::bytea AS right_sort_key, ARRAY[]::text[] AS discovery_channels FROM @{records/crm} AS empty WHERE false
SELECT 0::bigint AS candidate_pairs FROM @{records/crm} AS empty WHERE false

SELECT NULL::uuid AS left_source_record_id, NULL::uuid AS right_source_record_id, NULL::bytea AS left_sort_key, NULL::bytea AS right_sort_key, NULL::text AS rule, NULL::text AS evidence_group, NULL::text AS class, NULL::smallint AS score, NULL::text AS comparator, NULL::smallint AS comparator_version, NULL::bytea AS left_value_digest, NULL::bytea AS right_value_digest FROM @{records/crm} AS empty WHERE false

SELECT NULL::uuid AS source_record_id, NULL::text AS source_name, NULL::text AS field_name, NULL::integer AS source_priority, NULL::timestamptz AS row_changed_at, NULL::boolean AS authoritative, NULL::bytea AS source_sort_key, NULL::text AS raw_value, NULL::text AS state, NULL::text AS normalized, NULL::bytea AS canonical_bytes FROM @{records/crm} AS empty WHERE false AND (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM @{records/crm}) >= 0 AND (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM @{normalized/email}) >= 0 AND (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM @{pairs/customer}) >= 0 AND (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM @{pair-stats/customer}) >= 0 AND (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM @{pair-overflow/customer}) >= 0 AND (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM @{evidence/customer}) >= 0 /* @{evidence/customer} */
